title: Coherent augmented vertex diagrams, pointwise extension cones and iterated pullback models
statement: Use the simplicial and coherent comma-cone notions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a small ordinary category $J$, write $N_uJ$ for its nerve lifted into the ambient universe $u$. Put $I=\Delta_+^{\mathrm{op}}$, using Mathlib's augmented simplex category, and let $j$ be the full inclusion of its objects $[-1]$ and $[0]$. For $U:N_uI\to C$ and $k\in I$, its prescribed pointwise cone is the natural transformation from the constant $k$ diagram to the codomain diagram on $(k\downarrow j)$, followed by $U$; define the pointwise right Kan extension predicate by requiring each of these specified coherent cones to be limiting. A prescribed cone is limiting when its apex and entire cylinder agree with a limiting cone in the recorded comma-cone model. For $n\geq0$, put $V_n=\operatorname{WithTerminal}(\operatorname{Discrete}(\operatorname{Fin}(n+1)))$, with central object $b$. Its boundary sends every leaf to $[0]$, $b$ to $[-1]$, and every leaf arrow to the augmentation. Its cone legs from $[n]$ are the vertex restrictions and augmentation. The specified binary square has apex $[n+1]$, old leaf $[n]$ via the first $n+1$ vertices, new leaf $[0]$ via the last vertex, and center $[-1]$. Pullback existence means existence of limiting cones on all $N_uV_1$ diagrams. For $\theta:[m]\to[n]$, the star-selection functor sends leaf $r$ to $\theta(r)$ and fixes $b$; the comparison triangle has columns $[n],[m]$, and the degree-$m$ boundary. The universal triangle on the category of vertex-marked ordinals has columns $[-1],[0],[n]$ and arrows the empty and marked-vertex inclusions; its opposite nerve followed by $U$ supplies all higher coordinate comparisons. Finally define an iterated pullback model on the left cone of $V_n$ recursively: at $n=0$ its leaf leg is the identity; at $n+1$ it extends to the left cone of $\operatorname{WithTerminal}(\operatorname{WithInitial}(\operatorname{Discrete}(\operatorname{Fin}(n+1)))\sqcup\operatorname{Discrete}(\{*\}))$, whose old-cone restriction is a recursive model and whose new-apex/old-apex/new-leaf/base square is limiting. These restrictions retain every old leaf, the new leaf and their common augmentation.
